acceptance.given: S16 evidence is collected using the bound Toolchain test selector.

a schema file used as the S16 behavior test
a capability descriptor used as the S16 behavior test
an old receipt used as the S16 behavior test

Deriving new slice grouping from original slice IDs

acceptance.then: The compiler rejects any identity or grouping derived from an original slice ID.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The canonical-compilation check proves every new compiled identity and grouping is canonical-compilation-owned and rejects every original-slice-ID derivation.

acceptance.given: A test is declared planned but its real assertions have not both been authored and executed.

oracle.expected: The assessment reports present or missing evidence only after that test's real assertions are authored and executed.

Treating planned status alone as missing evidence
oracle.observable: The planned-test assessment classification linked to authored-and-executed assertion results.

acceptance.then: A plan alone produces neither a present-test nor missing-evidence claim.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A planned test without authored and executed real assertions cannot be classified as present or missing evidence.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require planned-test evidence assessment to wait for authored and executed real assertions before emitting a present or missing status.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain planned declarations but do not grant them test-presence or evidence semantics.

slice_hint.state_transition: A planned test remains unclassified evidence until real assertions are authored and executed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The assessment permits a present or missing evidence conclusion only when it observes authored real assertions and their execution result.
